description: The IM3 TELL team releases sample meteorological forcing for hourly electricity-load projections in the United States. Zenodo lists a public ZIP under CC BY 4.0. The description identifies five historical WRF years, 2015–2019, and four future years, 2039, 2059, 2079 and 2099, from RCP 8.5 with SSP5 population forcing. County hourly values for temperature, humidity, wind components and radiation are spatially averaged from WRF and then population-weighted into annual time series for TELL balancing authorities. A sample GCAM-USA output and two county population projections are also named. This package can test weather-sensitive demand and climate-stress simulations with TELL. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this forcing release. A limitation is that the four future years are selected examples, not a continuous climate projection or observed loads. County aggregation can hide urban heat or local outage effects. The ZIP was not downloaded, and variable units and region completeness were not checked.
